name: Software Developer
description: Designs, builds, and maintains software applications and systems.
what_they_do: Write code, debug programs, develop web and mobile apps, collaborate with teams using modern frameworks.

name: Systems Analyst
description: Analyzes and designs IT solutions to improve business processes and efficiency.
what_they_do: Evaluate current systems, gather requirements, design solutions, and coordinate between users and developers.

name: Data Analyst
description: Collects, processes, and interprets data to help organizations make informed decisions.
what_they_do: Clean and organize data, create reports and dashboards, identify trends and patterns.

name: IT Support Specialist
description: Provides technical support and troubleshooting for computer systems and networks.
what_they_do: Diagnose hardware and software issues, set up equipment, maintain network infrastructure.

name: Network Administrator
description: Manages and maintains an organization's computer networks and systems.
what_they_do: Configure routers and switches, monitor network performance, implement security measures.

name: Civil Engineer
description: Designs, plans, and oversees construction of infrastructure projects like roads and buildings.
what_they_do: Create structural designs, supervise construction sites, ensure safety compliance, prepare cost estimates.

name: Structural Engineer
description: Specializes in designing load-bearing structures to ensure safety and stability.
what_they_do: Analyze structural loads, design frameworks, inspect existing structures, prepare technical reports.

name: Construction Manager
description: Oversees construction projects from planning to completion, managing budgets and teams.
what_they_do: Coordinate contractors, monitor progress, manage budgets, ensure safety and quality standards.

name: Industrial Technician
description: Installs, maintains, and repairs industrial equipment and machinery.
what_they_do: Perform preventive maintenance, diagnose mechanical issues, repair equipment, read technical diagrams.

name: Production Supervisor
description: Oversees manufacturing operations and ensures production targets are met efficiently.
what_they_do: Supervise production staff, monitor output quality, implement process improvements, manage schedules.

name: Quality Control Analyst
description: Tests and inspects products to ensure they meet quality standards before distribution.
what_they_do: Conduct product tests, document results, identify defects, recommend corrective actions.

name: Quality Control Manager
description: Leads quality assurance teams and develops quality standards for production processes.
what_they_do: Design quality policies, oversee inspection teams, conduct audits, drive continuous improvement.

name: Business Manager
description: Plans and directs business operations to achieve organizational goals and growth.
what_they_do: Develop strategies, manage teams, oversee finances, analyze market trends, drive profitability.

name: Entrepreneur
description: Starts and manages businesses, identifying opportunities and creating value in the market.
what_they_do: Develop business ideas, secure funding, manage operations, build customer relationships, innovate products.

name: Marketing Specialist
description: Develops and executes marketing campaigns to promote products and build brand awareness.
what_they_do: Create marketing materials, manage social media, analyze campaign performance, conduct market research.

name: Human Resource Specialist
description: Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, and organizational development.
what_they_do: Screen and interview candidates, handle employee concerns, manage payroll, develop training programs.

name: Event Coordinator
description: Plans and organizes events from conception to execution, managing all logistics and vendors.
what_they_do: Coordinate with clients and vendors, manage budgets, arrange venues, oversee event setup and execution.

name: Hotel Manager
description: Oversees daily hotel operations to ensure excellent guest experiences and profitable performance.
what_they_do: Manage staff, handle guest complaints, monitor budgets, ensure cleanliness and safety standards.

name: Restaurant Manager
description: Manages restaurant operations including staff, inventory, customer service, and profitability.
what_they_do: Hire and train staff, manage food inventory, ensure food quality, handle customer feedback, control costs.

name: Agribusiness Manager
description: Manages agricultural production and business operations from farm to market.
what_they_do: Plan crop production, manage budgets, coordinate distribution, analyze market trends, supervise farm workers.

name: Farm Manager
description: Oversees daily farm operations including crop production, livestock management, and farm staff.
what_they_do: Plan planting and harvest schedules, manage farm equipment, monitor crop health, supervise workers.

name: Public Administrator
description: Develops and implements government policies and programs for public service and community development.
what_they_do: Analyze policy options, manage government projects, coordinate with stakeholders, prepare budget proposals.

name: Actuary
description: Analyzes financial risks using mathematics and statistics to help insurance and finance companies.
what_they_do: Calculate insurance premiums, assess financial risks, build statistical models, prepare reports.

name: Statistician
description: Applies statistical methods to collect, analyze, and interpret data across various fields.
what_they_do: Design surveys and experiments, analyze data using software, present findings, advise on data-driven decisions.

name: Research Statistician
description: Specializes in designing research studies and analyzing data for scientific and social research.
what_they_do: Develop research methodologies, perform complex statistical analyses, interpret results, write research papers.

name: Biologist
description: Studies living organisms and their environments to advance scientific knowledge and applications.
what_they_do: Conduct lab and field research, analyze biological samples, document findings, contribute to conservation efforts.

name: Environmental Scientist
description: Studies the environment and develops solutions to environmental problems like pollution and conservation.
what_they_do: Collect environmental samples, analyze data, conduct field assessments, recommend sustainability practices.

name: Agricultural Entrepreneur
description: Builds and manages agricultural ventures combining farming knowledge with business innovation.
what_they_do: Identify market opportunities, develop agri-business models, manage production, build supply chains.

name: Agricultural Extension Officer
description: Educates and supports farmers on modern agricultural practices and technologies.
what_they_do: Conduct training sessions, demonstrate new farming techniques, provide technical advice, distribute resources.

name: Agriculturist
description: Applies scientific principles to crop production, soil management, and sustainable farming practices.
what_they_do: Analyze soil and crop conditions, advise on pest control, recommend fertilizers, improve yield quality.

name: Conservation Officer
description: Protects natural resources and enforces environmental laws in forests, parks, and protected areas.
what_they_do: Patrol natural areas, enforce environmental regulations, conduct wildlife surveys, educate the public.

name: Sustainability Consultant
description: Advises organizations on sustainable practices to reduce environmental impact and improve efficiency.
what_they_do: Conduct environmental audits, recommend green solutions, develop sustainability plans, track progress.

name: Teacher
description: Educates and inspires students across various subjects and grade levels in formal school settings.
what_they_do: Plan lessons, deliver instruction, assess student progress, manage classrooms, guide student development.

name: Early Childhood Teacher
description: Teaches and nurtures young children aged 3–5 in preschool and early learning settings.
what_they_do: Design age-appropriate activities, develop social skills, teach basic literacy and numeracy, ensure safety.

name: Elementary Teacher
description: Teaches foundational subjects to elementary school students and supports their overall development.
what_they_do: Teach core subjects, create engaging lessons, assess student learning, communicate with parents.

name: Preschool Teacher
description: Provides early childhood education and care for children before they enter formal schooling.
what_they_do: Plan play-based learning activities, teach basic skills, monitor child development, collaborate with parents.

name: Preschool Administrator
description: Manages preschool operations including curriculum, staff, finances, and parent relations.
what_they_do: Oversee teachers, develop school policies, manage enrollment, ensure regulatory compliance, coordinate with parents.

name: Math Teacher
description: Teaches mathematics concepts and problem-solving skills to students in secondary education.
what_they_do: Prepare math lessons, explain concepts, assign practice problems, assess understanding, provide remediation.

name: Mathematics Teacher
description: Specializes in teaching advanced mathematics at the secondary or tertiary education level.
what_they_do: Teach algebra, geometry, calculus and statistics, develop curriculum materials, advise math clubs.

name: Science Teacher
description: Teaches scientific concepts through lectures, demonstrations, and laboratory experiments.
what_they_do: Develop science curricula, conduct lab experiments, explain theories, assess student learning, promote scientific inquiry.

name: English Teacher
description: Teaches English language and literature, developing students' reading, writing, and communication skills.
what_they_do: Plan literature and writing lessons, grade essays, teach grammar, facilitate discussions, promote literacy.

name: Filipino Teacher
description: Teaches Filipino language and literature, promoting linguistic and cultural appreciation.
what_they_do: Teach Filipino grammar and literature, develop instructional materials, assess language proficiency.

name: PE Teacher
description: Promotes physical fitness and healthy lifestyles through structured physical education programs.
what_they_do: Lead sports and fitness activities, teach health concepts, organize athletic events, assess physical development.

name: Technology Teacher
description: Teaches technology and computer-related subjects, preparing students for the digital age.
what_they_do: Teach computer literacy, programming basics, and digital skills, maintain lab equipment, develop tech curricula.

name: Curriculum Developer
description: Designs and improves educational curricula, learning materials, and assessment tools.
what_they_do: Research educational standards, develop lesson frameworks, create learning materials, evaluate curriculum effectiveness.

name: Curriculum Specialist
description: Provides expert guidance on curriculum design and instructional strategies for educational institutions.
what_they_do: Evaluate current curricula, recommend improvements, train teachers, align programs with educational standards.

name: Special Education Teacher
description: Teaches students with diverse learning needs, adapting instruction to individual abilities.
what_they_do: Develop individualized education plans, use adaptive teaching methods, collaborate with therapists and parents.

name: Special Education Assistant
description: Supports special education teachers in implementing individualized learning plans for students.
what_they_do: Assist with classroom activities, provide one-on-one support, help with behavior management, prepare materials.

name: Inclusion Specialist
description: Ensures students with disabilities receive appropriate support to succeed in inclusive classrooms.
what_they_do: Assess student needs, coordinate support services, train staff on inclusion practices, advocate for students.

name: Tutor
description: Provides individualized academic support to students outside the regular classroom setting.
what_they_do: Assess student weaknesses, explain concepts one-on-one, provide practice exercises, track progress.

name: Vocational Instructor
description: Teaches practical skills and trades in vocational and technical education programs.
what_they_do: Demonstrate hands-on skills, assess student competencies, maintain workshop equipment, develop training modules.

name: Language Instructor
description: Teaches foreign or second languages to students in schools, language centers, or corporate settings.
what_they_do: Plan language lessons, teach speaking and writing skills, assess proficiency, develop learning materials.

name: Laboratory Instructor
description: Guides students and researchers in conducting laboratory experiments safely and effectively.
what_they_do: Prepare lab equipment and materials, demonstrate procedures, enforce safety protocols, assess lab reports.

name: Clinical Instructor
description: Supervises and trains nursing and health science students in clinical practice settings.
what_they_do: Demonstrate clinical procedures, supervise student practice, evaluate clinical competencies, provide feedback.

name: Registered Nurse
description: Provides patient care, health education, and medical support in hospitals and healthcare settings.
what_they_do: Administer medications, monitor vital signs, assist doctors, educate patients, maintain medical records.

name: Public Health Nurse
description: Promotes community health through disease prevention, health education, and public health programs.
what_they_do: Conduct immunization drives, perform health screenings, educate communities, track disease outbreaks.

name: Behavior Therapist
description: Helps individuals with behavioral challenges develop positive behaviors and coping strategies.
what_they_do: Assess behavior patterns, develop intervention plans, conduct therapy sessions, track progress, train caregivers.

name: Psychologist
description: Studies mental processes and behavior, providing assessment, therapy, and research services.
what_they_do: Conduct psychological assessments, provide counseling, design intervention programs, conduct research.

name: Guidance Counselor
description: Helps students navigate academic, career, and personal challenges through counseling and guidance programs.
what_they_do: Conduct individual and group counseling, administer career assessments, guide students in course selection.

name: Child Development Specialist
description: Supports the developmental needs of children from infancy through adolescence.
what_they_do: Assess developmental milestones, design intervention programs, counsel parents, collaborate with educators.

name: Criminologist
description: Studies crime patterns, criminal behavior, and the criminal justice system to inform policy and prevention.
what_they_do: Analyze crime data, study criminal behavior, advise law enforcement, contribute to crime prevention programs.

name: Forensic Investigator
description: Collects and analyzes physical evidence from crime scenes to support criminal investigations.
what_they_do: Process crime scenes, collect evidence, conduct lab analysis, prepare reports, testify in court.

name: Law Enforcement Officer
description: Maintains public safety by enforcing laws, responding to emergencies, and preventing crime.
what_they_do: Patrol communities, respond to incidents, investigate crimes, make arrests, testify in court.

name: Lawyer (after law school)
description: Provides legal advice, represents clients in court, and advocates for justice and legal rights.
what_they_do: Research legal cases, draft legal documents, argue in court, advise clients, negotiate settlements.

name: Legislative Assistant
description: Supports legislators in research, policy analysis, and administrative tasks for effective lawmaking.
what_they_do: Research policy issues, draft bills and speeches, coordinate with stakeholders, manage schedules.

name: Policy Analyst
description: Researches and evaluates public policies to recommend improvements for social and economic issues.
what_they_do: Analyze policy impacts, conduct research, write policy briefs, consult stakeholders, propose recommendations.

name: Development Communicator
description: Uses communication strategies to promote social change, community development, and public awareness.
what_they_do: Create advocacy campaigns, produce educational materials, engage communities, evaluate program impact.

name: Media Specialist
description: Creates and manages media content across platforms including print, digital, broadcast, and social media.
what_they_do: Write articles, produce multimedia content, manage social media accounts, coordinate media campaigns.

name: Community Relations Officer
description: Builds and maintains positive relationships between organizations and their surrounding communities.
what_they_do: Organize community events, address public concerns, manage outreach programs, represent the organization.

name: Researcher
description: Conducts systematic investigations to discover new knowledge or solve practical problems.
what_they_do: Design research studies, collect and analyze data, write papers, present findings, apply for grants.

name: Sports Program Coordinator
description: Organizes and manages sports programs, events, and athletic activities for schools or communities.
what_they_do: Plan sports events, coordinate teams, manage facilities, promote athletic participation, ensure safety.

name: Coach
description: Trains and guides athletes to improve performance, develop skills, and achieve competitive goals.
what_they_do: Design training programs, teach techniques, analyze performance, motivate athletes, plan game strategies.

name: Livelihood Educator
description: Teaches practical livelihood skills to help communities achieve economic self-sufficiency.
what_they_do: Conduct skills training, develop livelihood programs, mentor participants, evaluate program outcomes.
